title: NovaCorp IT & Device Usage Policy
content:
NovaCorp IT and Device Usage Policy — Version 3.2 — June 2025

1. APPROVED DEVICES
All employees must use NovaCorp-approved devices for work purposes. Personal devices (BYOD) may access company email and approved SaaS tools only after MDM (Mobile Device Management) enrollment and IT security approval. Personal devices are prohibited from accessing sensitive internal systems, source code repositories, or classified data without explicit CTO approval.

2. NETWORK SECURITY
VPN is mandatory when accessing internal NovaCorp systems from outside the office. Employees must not connect to public Wi-Fi without VPN active. Home networks used for work must have WPA2 or WPA3 encryption enabled. IT reserves the right to audit network access logs for security purposes.

3. SOFTWARE INSTALLATION
Only IT-approved software may be installed on company devices. Employees must not disable antivirus, endpoint protection, or device encryption. Shadow IT (unauthorized SaaS subscriptions) is prohibited. Software requests must be submitted through the IT ticketing system.

4. DATA HANDLING
Company data must not be stored on personal cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud) without IT approval. Approved cloud storage includes NovaCorp SharePoint and approved enterprise tools. External hard drives must be encrypted and registered with IT.

5. INCIDENT REPORTING
Security incidents including lost devices, phishing emails, and suspicious activity must be reported to IT Security within 2 hours via security@novacorp.com or the IT helpdesk. Failure to report may result in disciplinary action.

6. VIOLATIONS
Violations of this policy are subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination. In cases involving data breach, legal prosecution may apply.
